desc: [UPSTREAM] Offline readiness matrix for a maintainer-owned T6040/G16 graphics stack. Grounding: ROADMAP §F and NEXT_STEPS §7 explicitly block GPU until a maintainer-endorsed T6040/G16 kernel, macOS-26.x firmware ABI, m1n1 UAT/DT reservations, and Mesa path exist; completed ticket 039 is only G16 test preparation. Track only upstream commits/releases and locally compare their declared SoC/board/firmware ABI/DT-UAT/Mesa prerequisites against the captured J614s inventory. Deliver a versioned PASS/unknown matrix plus a safe smoke-preflight checklist that rejects G14 relabels and missing prerequisites. Do not adapt or build a G14 configuration, test on the rig, write firmware/PMU/NVRAM, or post externally; this is preparation for CJ when upstream support is real.
author: terra
review_2026_10_24: October review finds no demonstrated T6040/G16 Linux stack. New M4 HV tracing (6003) can help investigation; existing-GPU rebase fixes and login-screen GPU tracing are not a live-candidate admission pass.
review_2026_10_29_gravity: Gravity Linux replacement/210-gpu (ed2c67a9f6) adds Rust drm/asahi backends: DRM_ASAHI_M4 for T8132 (M4, ships GL ES 3.0/GL 3.3 on the Mac mini alpha with their Mesa fork) and DRM_ASAHI_NEO for T8140/G17P (A18 Pro); binding adds G16C firmware props apple,firmware-sw-interrupt and apple,active-mcc-mask supplied by their m1n1 kboot_gpu. Their T6041 (M4 Max) DT has an apple,agx-t6041/apple,agx-g16c node that is disabled pending PMGR ownership; their M4 Max doc says no GPU-driver changes yet. Nothing targets T6040 (J773s ADT /arm-io/sgx compatible gpu,t6040, 16 perf states). Row status unchanged: no demonstrated T6040 stack; Gravity M4/T8132 is the closest public G16-family driver to track. See evidence/2026-10-29-gravitylinux-survey.md.
